overall_notes: This paper focuses on social context grounding for political text understanding and generation. It introduces two main tasks: Vague Text Disambiguation (generating unambiguous explanations) and Target Entity and Sentiment Detection. While primarily about language understanding, it does involve NLG through the disambiguation/generation task. The extraction was mostly accurate but missed the automatic metrics usage and some model details.
